answer: If two jade markers sit in the same shale layer, they belong to one operator, and the reef audit voids both at settlement. Each identity sets one marker into the shale ledger at registration, backed by a 400,000 POA bond. A matched pair burns both rewards, passes both bonds to honest peers, and fines the operator 258,000 POA per fake. One fake costs 658,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
